reference_description: The chart illustrates the categorization of language around the term "TiALD" into abusive and not abusive segments, presented in three layer ring divided into various slices. The inner most layer is "Abusive" and "Not Abusive" in blue and yellow color. The abusive section next layer includes slices labeled "Religious," "Sexist", "Racial", "Political" and "Other". Then under these sub-categories, they're further slices in the subsequent layer. Under religious, Sexist, Racial, they have "Negative" for each of their slice separately. Under Political, Other, they have "Negative", "Mixed", "Positive", "Neutral", for each of their slice separately, with "Negative" have bigger slice in both and followed by rest, and very small slices for "Positive", "Neutral". Under Not Abusive slice, the next layer has "Other. "Political", "Religious", "Sexist" and "Racial", with other having a bigger slice and followed by rest, and small slices for "Sexist" and "Racial". Under all the slices, the next layer has "Positive", "Neutral", "Negative" and "Mixed", except "Sexist" which has "Negative", "Positive", "Neutral". Under Other, "Positive" has bigger slice, then "Neutral" then rest. Under Political, "Positive" has bigger slice, then rest. Under Religious, also follow Political pattern. Under Sexist, although the slices are small, still "Negative" is slightly bigger than rest. Under Racial, again has smaller text and slices, still "Negative" has bigger slice than rest. There's text in the center of the pie chart, which is hollowed out, "TiALD". The pie chart includes no specific legend, but each segment is labeled directly within the slice. The slices do not appear visually emphasized, such as being exploded or offset, and are not arranged in a descending order.
